questions.reasoning: STEP-BY-STEP PLAN: 1. Scenario: A University Library is organized into several sections such as fiction, children and technology. Each section has a name and a unique number and its headed by a head librarian. The library also has a system for tracking book loans and member information. 2. Sub-questions: (a) Design an ER diagram to represent the relationships between students, books, sections, librarians and members. (b) Explain the concept of aggregation in the context of the University Library scenario. (c) Describe how you would enforce overlapping constraints in the database schema for the library system. (d) Calculate the number of unique combinations of book titles and authors. (e) Design a table to store member information, including membership number, address, phone number, and borrowing history.
